HONS 470.d: RUSP is a two-semester course for students pursuing careers in academia/research. With a faculty mentor, students engage in a year-long research project and attend weekly seminars on how to conduct and present research, work in the academy, apply to post-undergraduate education and fellowships, and understand the social impact of research. Instructor Permission Required.
HONS 470.restr: Enrollment is limited to Undergraduate, Undergraduate Professional or Visiting Undergraduate level students.
